literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe C-terminal tags on full-length ATRNL1: a 1D4 tag (L1/L2) and a 3×FLAG tag (L3/L4). ATRNL1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein whose C-terminus (residue 1379) falls within the intracellular region (residues 1253–1379), as established by the authoritative topology landmarks (TM: 1230–1252; intracellular: 1253–1379). A C-terminal tag therefore sits on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular surface. No ledger line reports a tag inserted into the large extracellular domain (residues 53–1229) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 52). Because no ledger line grounds an extracellular insertion, zero sites are proposed. The C-terminal tag positions are recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 1D4 tag on full-length ATRNL1; residue 1379 lies in the intracellular tail (residues 1253–1379), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
C-terminal 3×FLAG tag on full-length ATRNL1 (ATRNL1-3Flag); same intracellular C-terminus as L1; used in co-IP and surface ELISA assays but the tag itself is cytoplasmic.
